name: 👑 Alara
party: year-level backbone — c. dates; traditional founder of the Napatan royal line

name: 👑 Kashta
party: year-level backbone — c. dates; extended Kushite power into Upper Egypt

name: 👑 Piye
party: year-level backbone — conquered Egypt — founder of Egypt's 25th (Kushite) Dynasty; shared crown with the ancient-egypt entity

name: 👑 Shebitku
party: year-level backbone — 25th-Dynasty pharaoh of Egypt (revised chronology places him before Shabaka); Egypt overlap

name: 👑 Shabaka
party: year-level backbone — 25th-Dynasty pharaoh of Egypt; Egypt overlap

name: 👑 Taharqa
party: year-level backbone — greatest 25th-Dynasty pharaoh; driven from Egypt by Assyria; Egypt overlap

name: 👑 Tantamani
party: year-level backbone — last Kushite pharaoh of Egypt — lost Egypt to Assyria; ruled in Kush until after 656 BC

name: 👑 Aspelta
party: year-level backbone — c. dates; gap c. 656–600 BC (Atlanersa, Senkamanisken, Anlamani — reigns only broadly datable); Napata sacked by Psamtik II 592, court shifted toward Meroë

name: 👑 Arakamani
party: year-level backbone — c. 270 BC–mid-3rd century (end year approximate); gap c. 580–270 BC — sparse Napatan record; first ruler buried at Meroë

name: 👑 Amanirenas
party: year-level backbone — c. dates; gap c. 250–40 BC; kandake who fought Rome in the war of 25–22 BC and won favourable terms from Augustus

name: 👑 Amanitore
party: year-level backbone — dates approximate — source says only 'middle 1st century CE'; co-ruled with King Natakamani, great builders of Meroë; gap c. 10 BC–40 CE (Amanishakheto et al. only broadly datable)

name: 👑 Amanipilade
party: year-level backbone — dates approximate — 'middle 4th century CE'; last attested ruler before the kingdom's fall to Aksum c. 350 CE; gap c. 60–340 CE — late Meroitic rulers only broadly datable
